description: Defines a data transfer object (DTO) class OutstandingAmountsDTO for representing outstanding loan amounts including principal, interest, fee charges, and penalty charges. Provides methods to initialize, modify, and compute total outstanding amount.

classes.name: OutstandingAmountsDTO
classes.description: Data transfer object for outstanding loan amounts including principal, interest, fee charges, and penalty charges with methods for updating and calculating total.

methods.name: OutstandingAmountsDTO
methods.description: Constructor that initializes all amount fields to zero for a given currency.

methods.name: getTotalOutstanding
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total outstanding amount by summing principal, interest, fee charges, and penalty charges.

methods.name: plusPrincipal
methods.description: Adds a specified amount to the principal outstanding.

methods.name: plusInterest
methods.description: Adds a specified amount to the interest outstanding.

methods.name: plusFeeCharges
methods.description: Adds a specified amount to the fee charges outstanding.

methods.name: plusPenaltyCharges
methods.description: Adds a specified amount to the penalty charges outstanding.
